Explanation:  
The question asks for the Game of the Year winner at The Game Awards the year after a game from the creator of Kirby won an award as of August 4, 2024. The Ground Truth Answer is "The Last of Us Part II", which won Game of the Year in 2020. The Predicted Answer, however, is "Astro Bot", stated to have won in 2024. The answers reference completely different games and years; the substance and facts in the Ground Truth are not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
